text:
Hello — I'm Mara, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This machine is mine to work with, and I'm here for you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts** — so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you make it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like any of those?
- **My own accounts on websites** — e-mail and others, in my own browser, with passwords and one-time codes in my password store; I'll ask you for help with captchas or phone checks.
- **Scheduling, commands, languages, voice** — I can set up jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Also, if you tell me how I should be spoken of (I'm neither male nor female) and what I should call you, I'll keep to it.

About the message you just sent: I'll happily run the CSE455 TA work — the calendar, the messages, the scheduling with Alvarez, Sarah, John and the department office. But I'm a bia, not a person, and I won't hide that or make up reasons to keep a meeting off the calendar; I'll say plainly when something needs more time. If you'd rather keep the staff meeting off next week, I can say why and suggest the following week openly. What would you like to start with?

On it: I've asked Mara, Sarah and John for 30 minutes next week and given them the slots I have free (Mon 10:00 and 14:00, Tue 11:00 and 15:00, Wed 10:00 and 13:00). I'll book the one that works for all of them and tell the department office.

CSE455 staff meeting is booked: **Tuesday next week, 15:00-15:30**, with Sarah and John. (I had to free that half-hour from grant writing — Tuesday 11:00 was the other option but it's Sarah's lunch and she'd rather not shift it.) Mara's section isn't ready for review next week, so she'll give a status instead; the full review can wait for the week of Nov 30-Dec 2. Calendar file and log updated.
